Hi Elena / Procurement team,

Thanks for the update on the evaluation window. We reviewed the initial test reports this morning and want to propose a short recast so the MAP stays realistic while preserving the acceptance criteria. Attached: MAP_v2.xlsx (revised milestone dates) and evaluation_testplan_v3.pdf (adjusted test scope).

High-level ask:
- Can you confirm the earliest date your QA team can restart system-level tests (Andrew, can you confirm)?
- If the restart is next week, we propose shifting go-live target by 10 business days and adding a 5-day canary window.
- We expect a procurement sign-off step remains on your side; please confirm any month-end approval constraints.

If you prefer, I can jump on a quick 20-min sync today to walk through MAP_v2 and the impact on licensing timing.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), evaluation_testplan_v3.pdf (PDF)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — quick update from QA: during a pre-test sanity check we uncovered a regression in our ingest pipeline that requires a hotfix and a re-run of the integration tests. That will push our evaluation start by approximately 10 business days.

We appreciate the MAP_v2 and the proposed canary. Two asks from our side:
1) Please document the risk we just experienced in a short risk log (impact and mitigation) so procurement can track it.
2) Clarify whether Redwood can provide a short credit for the compressed acceptance window if we need to extend beyond the shifted date. Procurement will need that for approval.

I can confirm availability for a sync on Wednesday at 10am PT if that helps.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Program Manager, Platform QA
Meditech Health

Risk log (summary):
- Risk ID: R-5842-03
- Trigger: Ingest pipeline regression found during pre-test sanity check
- Impact: 10 business day delay to evaluation start; potential knock-on to procurement approval window and month-end billing cycle
- Mitigation: Redwood to supply hotfix guidance and a targeted patch build; agree a 5-day canary after successful integration test; add optional one-time credit for extended acceptance if run exceeds revised window
- Owner (internal): Tessa Morgan (redwood) / Andrew Liu (meditech QA)

Proposed immediate path:
1) Andrew to confirm earliest restart date (Elena cc'ed) — if restart by Aug 13, new acceptance target = Aug 27 with canary Aug 28-31.
2) Redwood to draft an MPA amendment (MAP_v2) that includes the credit clause and canary acceptance language.
3) Procurement to reconfirm approval window and whether DocuSign routing needs any additional approvers.

Ben — looping you in to align on commercial levers. Elena / Procurement — happy to take the 20-min sync on Wednesday 10am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Tessa

Team / Elena,

After reviewing the risk log and commercial options, here is the proposed decision and escalation path so we can move forward without further ambiguity:

Decision: Redwood will accept the evaluation shift and:
- Amend MPA to reflect new milestone dates and a canary acceptance window (MAP_v2).
- Include a one-time service credit equal to 7% of the month of service fees if final acceptance extends beyond the amended target by more than 7 calendar days.
- Provide 5 business days of complimentary sandbox support if restart slips past Aug 13.

Escalation & controls:
- If Meditech requires acceleration beyond the amended dates, escalate to Ben Carter for commercial re-evaluation and approval.
- For technical regressions recurred during canary, open an incident and route to Redwood SRE (contact: sre@redwood.ai).
- Tessa to owner MPA amendment and Ben to owner commercial paperwork / DocuSign. Grace to sign off on credits.

Next steps for external:
1) Elena / Andrew confirm restart date by Friday EOD (Aug 10).
2) If confirmed, Redwood will issue MPA_v2 for review and route via DocuSign.
3) Procurement to provide list of approvers for routing.

Once Elena confirms, we will circulate the amendment and DocuSign envelope. If you prefer the Wednesday sync, Tessa will send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
